targetText: If I don't get: some means of earning a living soon, there is only one thing left for me ; the street.
explanation: In 'Sisters', Kollontai highlights the desperation of unemployed working women who are pushed toward prostitution when social support fails.

targetText: Yes. I worked in the shipping department of our publishing house until two months ago, when I lost my place ... because of my baby. It was so sick, and I had to stay at home again and again to take care of it. It died two weeks after I lost my position, but I was not taken back.
explanation: Exposing the brutality of workplace discrimination against working mothers whose caregiving responsibilities lead to dismissal and poverty.
